speaker: Doctor
text: I need to understand the onset of your gait and limb ataxia; did this develop gradually over months or acutely over days? Additionally, have you noticed any changes in your vision, balance, or coordination?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for clarifying. To help narrow this down, are you currently taking any new medications or supplements, and have you experienced any recent falls or loss of consciousness? Also, do you have a history of autoimmune disorders or family members with similar neurological symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy.

REQUEST IMAGES: Brain MRI with and without contrast.
REQUEST TEST: JC Virus (JCV) PCR from CSF.
